notes.title: Official Announcement Trailer
notes.notes:
Hi everyone

With the release of our announcement trailer, we've also updated our store page to include alot of information
and gameplay screenshots for Visions of Evil.

We're thankful to everyone that has supported us to reach this point of the development. 
After 4 years we're very proud and eager to show you more of our upcoming asymmetrical horror game.

For more updates you can wishlist our game on steam and/or join our discord server.
You'll also find some more social links below.

We can't wait to show you more of Visions of Evil and force you to face your fears.

Thank you very much.

Visions of Evil Development Team
